about: #553 (B1). Gate 214 walks Italian Game practice with hints on at kunal761 and 320x568 (se), at move 1 and after e4, Nf3, Bc4 and c3, and reads the hint SPAN: not clamped, every word line inside it and the note box; at move 1 the hints-on warning keeps its line; the board still; after a move the confirm painted or behind 'more' (flags/amber-553-hint-takes-the-third-line). Breaks: the hint held at two lines again (the defect the check found, after c3 at kunal761); the span given the room but its clamp left at two; the move-1 warning giving way to the hint too. NOT COVERED: other lessons' hints (the checker's survey found 220 of 875 needing more than two lines at kunal761; a hint needing more than three is still clamped with an ellipsis and 'more'), and his phone's fonts.

breaks.name: hint-held-at-two-lines
breaks.why: the hint may never take the third line (hMax 2), so after c3 at kunal761 it is clamped at 'the old d4 is...'

breaks.name: span-clamp-stays-two
breaks.why: the prompt steps aside but the hint span's -webkit-line-clamp stays 2, so the third line is still not painted

breaks.name: warning-gives-way-at-move-1
breaks.why: at move 1 the hints-on warning steps behind 'more' too, so the player who just turned hints on is not told it costs the day
